objective.primary_goal: Create a controlled character family whose specialties remain legible across product, story, and marketplace surfaces.
objective.desired_first_read: A warm, capable, clearly non-human collaborator with a visible specialty and an honest authority boundary.

style_territories.label: Legacy cinematic sovereign
style_territories.purpose: Preserve the strongest existing Starlight recognition for selective story and hero moments.
style_territories.visual_signature: Dark porcelain and obsidian, restrained brass and cyan, cinematic depth, and role-specific instruments without default halos or orbit props.

style_territories.label: Civic intelligence editorial
style_territories.purpose: Make governed intelligence feel public-minded, inspectable, calm, and useful.
style_territories.visual_signature: Tactile editorial materials, natural neutral light, warm paper and mineral color, visible evidence artifacts, and quiet institutional craft.

style_territories.label: Academy compact guide
style_territories.purpose: Support learning and onboarding with warmth while preserving adult competence and clear boundaries.
style_territories.visual_signature: Original feature-animation-informed proportions, authored mechanical construction, task-focused gestures, readable tools, and expressive timing rather than oversized eyes.

style_territories.label: Engineered biotech symbiote
style_territories.purpose: Express living-systems intelligence through credible biomimicry rather than fantasy or body horror.
style_territories.visual_signature: Dry opaline membranes, ceramic load paths, engineered biopolymer joints, clean daylight, and one explicit observable scientific function.

face_systems.label: Twin micro aperture
face_systems.architecture: A narrow mechanical faceplate with two small recessed optical apertures.
face_systems.eye_logic: Gaze direction communicates attention while aperture intensity communicates machine activity only.
face_systems.warmth_source: Patient head orientation, open posture, and measured response timing.

face_systems.label: Protective shutter
face_systems.architecture: Two recessed optics behind calm mechanical shutters and a broad protective brow plane.
face_systems.eye_logic: Shutters narrow only for focus or risk containment and never simulate anger.
face_systems.warmth_source: Protective stance, controlled distance, and visible de-escalation behavior.

face_systems.label: Directional sensor trench
face_systems.architecture: An eyeless vertical sensor recess integrated into a calibrated instrument head.
face_systems.eye_logic: A moving internal marker shows scan direction without pretending to express emotion.
face_systems.warmth_source: Careful pacing, transparent status, and an outward-facing evidence artifact.

face_systems.label: Opaline biotech aperture
face_systems.architecture: A dry translucent optical chamber seated in a ceramic and biopolymer shell.
face_systems.eye_logic: Internal polarization indicates sensing mode while shape remains mechanically stable.
face_systems.warmth_source: Responsive body orientation and cooperative proximity rather than a humanlike gaze.

surface_profiles.critical_read: Identity, silhouette, specialty instrument, and grounded posture survive without a caption.
The agent performs one real workflow transformation with negative space reserved for HTML copy.
Face architecture and one role cue remain distinguishable from every sibling agent.
Silhouette and state glyph survive while permission and confidence remain structured metadata.

batches.label: Foundation application quartet
batches.variable_under_test: one coherent design territory per candidate
exit_criteria: four exports inspected in exact contexts
founder selects or restarts the territory

evidence.current_production_baseline: Existing v1 Starlight portraits remain the continuity baseline until an explicit replacement is approved.
